snippet.title: You Play As A Tiny Toy Car In A Giant World | Lost Host
snippet.description:
Lost Host is an atmospheric indie adventure game where you play as a tiny toy car searching for its missing owner.

Explore large environments from a toy’s perspective, solve puzzles, drive through obstacles, and uncover what really happened. The world feels enormous when you're just a small toy.

This gameplay trailer shows the core mechanics of Lost Host — driving, puzzle solving, exploration, and the emotional atmosphere of the story.

▶ Free demo on Steam
